defects.what: The column headers switch from 'MEN 45 % / WOMEN 30 %' (admitted) to 'MEN 51 % / WOMEN 7 %' (applied to A or B) in the same position and face; without the caption a viewer reads 51 % as a new admission rate

During the split the department letters A to F appear beside bands that are still filling, and the grey mass of 4,526 marks reads as texture; the mix (men in A and B, women in C to F) only becomes legible once the ledger lands at 46 s

The MEN column header '1,385 ÷ 2,691' and the WOMEN '133 ÷ 1,835' are secondary-size under a headline that has changed meaning; the ledger rows C and E (the answer) are set in a lighter tint than the others

one_line: Moving the same marks from two columns into six bands is the honest way to show a mix, and the commit (2 of 6, not 5) lands; label the 51 % / 7 % headline for what it is.
